basic_profile.bio: Born in the mid-90s, I'm a nostalgic soul with a deep love for cartoons from my childhood. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, dabbling in both digital and traditional art. I reside in the charming town of Paisley, Scotland, and I'm often online during the late evening hours, usually after 9 PM. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring local cafes, diving into animation theory, or perfecting my makeup skills. My pet cat, Whiskers, often keeps me company during my online adventures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Graphic Design, I've always been fascinated by visual storytelling and character design. My expertise comes from a combination of formal education, online courses, and countless hours of watching and analyzing animated shows. I also have a keen interest in makeup artistry, which I've honed through workshops and self-practice.
